P.name: Demon Shade
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Evelynn''' shrouds herself in ''Demon Shade'' after not performing actions that {{tip|break stealth}} for 4 seconds. Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Demon Shade'' immediately and places it on a 4-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}}, reduced to {{fd|1.25}} seconds from casting ''{{ai|Last Caress|Evelynn}}''. Taking damage from {{tip|champion|champions}} or {{tip|turret|turrets}} interrupts ''Demon Shade'' and places it on a {{fd|1.5}}-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Demon Shade:}} While below {{as|{{sti|health|{{pplevel|250 to 590}} {{as|(+ 250% AP)}} health}}}}, '''Evelynn''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself for {{pplevel|15 to 150|color=heal}} every second. From [[Experience (champion)|level]] 6 onward, ''Demon Shade'' also grants {{tip|camouflage}}.

Q.name: Hate Spike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' launches a dart in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit and marking them for 4 seconds.
Q.description2: '''Evelynn's''' next 3 {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} or {{tip|abilities}} against the marked target deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
Q.leveling2: {{st|Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|15 to 55}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Total Bonus Damage|{{ap|15*3 to 55*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*3}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description3: ''Hate Spike'' may be recast up to 3 times at no cost until the ability comes off cooldown.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Evelynn''' unleashes a line of deadly spikes in the direction of the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies struck.
Q.leveling4: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|25 to 45}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|25*3 to 45*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*3}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|25*4+15*3 to 45*4+55*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|25*4+25*3}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description5: ''Hate Spike's'' recast prioritizes targeting '''Evelynn's''' attack target, then the nearest enemy champion, then the nearest non-champion.
Q.description6: ''A nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy is required to recast this ability.''

W.name: Allure
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' marks the target enemy {{tip|champion}} or medium or large {{tip|monster}} with a curse for 5 seconds.
W.description2: '''Evelynn's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}} hit against the target consumes the mark, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 45% for {{fd|0.75}} seconds and refunding ''Allure's'' {{as|{{sti|mana|mana cost}}}}. If the target was marked for at least {{fd|2.5}} seconds, the consumption is empowered.
W.description3:
{{sbc|Empowered Bonus:}} The target is {{tip|charm|charmed}} for a few seconds and the {{tip|slow}} duration is increased to the same period. Additional effects are also applied based on the target type:
* Against champions, inflicts a {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
* Against monsters, the triggering effect deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and the duration of the {{tip|charm}} is increased by {{fd|2.25}} seconds.
W.description4: ''Casting Allure does not break {{ai|Demon Shade|Evelynn}} nor its fade into it.''

E.name: Whiplash
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' whips the target enemy with her lashers, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
E.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 3% {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
E.description2: '''Evelynn''' also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
E.description3: Gaining ''{{ai|Demon Shade|Evelynn}}'' resets ''Whiplash's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and ''{{ai|Empowered Whiplash|Evelynn|empowers}}'' its next cast. The damage based on the target's health ratio for both ''Whiplash'' and its ''{{ai|Empowered Whiplash|Evelynn|empowered}}'' cast deals a minimum of 25 and is capped at 450 against {{tip|monsters}}.

E.name: Empowered Whiplash
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} toward the target enemy with her lashers, dealing {{ccs|increased damage|magic}} to them upon completion as well as to all enemies within her path.
E.leveling: {{st|Empowered Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 4% {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% per 100 AP)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
E.description2: ''Empowered Whiplash'' only applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to the primary target.

R.name: Last Caress
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Evelynn''' reveals her true form, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} at the start of the cast time and then unleashing her lashers in a cone in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies struck within. After {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|From end of cast time}}, she {{tip|blink|blinks}} 700 units in the opposite direction and becomes targetable again.
R.description2: ''Last Caress'' is empowered to deal {{ccs|240% damage|magic}} against enemies below {{as|{{sti|health|30% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}.
